description:
FILED s446l (agent L) from #502 probes; PRE-EXISTING, silent wrong.

REPRO (perl vs ./runpcl):
  sub f1 { my (undef, $x) = @_; return $x }            perl B   PCL A
  sub f2 { my ($a, undef, $c) = @_; return "$a/$c" }  perl A/C PCL A/B
  sub f3 { my (undef, undef, $z) = @_; return $z }     perl C   PCL A
  print f1(qw(A B)), f2(qw(A B C)), f3(qw(A B C));

NOT a general list-assign bug -- these are RIGHT today, and that is the
discriminator: `my (undef, $v) = (1,2)` at file scope is 2; `sub f4 { my @c = @_;
my (undef,$x) = @c; $x }` is B; `sub f5 { my (undef,$x) = @_[0..1]; $x }` is B.
It fires ONLY when the RHS is literally @_ in the sub's FIRST statement, i.e.
the signature fast path.

CAUSE (located): Pl::Parser2::_extract_params (Pl/Parser2.pm ~7159) builds the
parameter list as
    map { $_->content } grep { $_->isa('PPI::Token::Symbol') } map { $_->tokens } $k[1]
-- it COLLECTS the symbols and silently discards everything else in the list,
so an `undef` placeholder (a PPI::Token::Word) vanishes and every name after it
moves one slot left.  The result feeds `p-raw-params` (and the boxed
`p-list-=` twin), both positional.

FIX SHAPE (smallest correct, and conservative): _extract_params DECLINES when
the list contains anything that is not a scalar Symbol or a comma -- the
statement then lowers as an ordinary `my (LIST) = @_` in the body, which is
already correct (f4/f5 prove the general path handles placeholders).  Binding a
gensym per placeholder would also work and keeps the fast path, but a decline
is the one-line version and the shape is rare.  Whichever is chosen, check
_leading_shift_params too (the W14 shift-coalescing twin) -- it matches only
`my $x = shift`, so it cannot see a placeholder, but the two are the same
family and a reviewer will ask.

BAR: the three shapes above + the three that already work (regression) + a
trailing placeholder + `my (undef) = @_` + a signature-shaped sub for contrast;
Pl/ change so corpus-diff + emission-ab (a decline CHANGES emission for any
corpus file with this spelling -- read the diffs, each is the bug); guard rows
in an existing Pl/t file.


=== DONE s448p (Opus agent P), commit b4f4ea6 ===

FIXED with the task's conservative shape: Pl::Parser2::_extract_params walks the
list's TOKENS and DECLINES unless every one of them is a scalar Symbol
(/^\$\w+$/), a comma (`,` or `=>`), the group's own parens, or an insignificant
token (whitespace, comment).  Nested parens are allowed through because perl
flattens them and they carry no slot, so `my (($a), $b) = @_` keeps the fast
path.  The statement then lowers as an ordinary `my (LIST) = @_`, which binds
placeholders correctly.

_leading_shift_params (the W14 twin) needed NO change and cannot need one: it
matches `my $x = shift`, whose k[1] is a Token::Symbol, so a Structure::List
never reaches it.  Noted in the commit for the reviewer who asks.

MEASUREMENTS
- corpus-diff vs HEAD: IDENTICAL over 111 files, silent drops 5 unchanged.
- emission-ab --ref HEAD over 1036 files (lib/**, perl 5.40.3 t/**, cpan-tests/**,
  Pl/t/shapes): 1035 SAME, 1 DIFF, RCDIFF 0.  The one diff IS the bug:
  t/op/inccode.t:293 `sub fake_module { my (undef,$module_file) = @_; !1 }` --
  an @INC hook whose $module_file was bound to the CODEREF perl passes as $_[0].
- op/inccode.t companion verdict unchanged (C 13/28 DIFF, same signature as
  baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv): the file aborts earlier for an unrelated
  reason, so NO suite movement is expected.
- 15 shapes probed vs perl 5.40.3, all identical after; f1/f2/f3 print A / A/B / A
  before.

GUARD: Pl/t/aassign-01.t 11 -> 18 rows (4.6 s).  Inverse-run on the base
Parser2: rows 12, 13, 14 and 18 FAIL, rows 15, 16, 17 (the already-right
regression guards) pass.

RESIDUE FILED: #610 -- `my (undef) = LIST`, a list that declares NO variable at
all, refuses the WHOLE FILE ("Parser2 TODO: unsupported declaration"), in a sub
and at file scope alike.  Pre-existing, loud, and _multi_decl's `!@vars` return
is the cause; out of this task's shape.
subject: `my (undef, $x) = @_;` in a sub binds $_[0], not $_[1] -- the params fast path DROPS undef placeholders and the remaining names shift LEFT (silent wrong)
